q: Where did the LORD send Jeremiah to receive His message?
quote: Go down at once to the potter’s house, and there I will reveal My message to you.

q: At the potter's house, what did Jeremiah see the potter working at?
quote: So I went down to the potter’s house and saw him working at the wheel.

q: At the potter's house, what was the potter shaping the vessel from?
quote: But the vessel that he was shaping from the clay became flawed in his hand

q: Jeremiah watched a potter. When the vessel became flawed, what did the potter do?
why: He reshaped it as seemed best.
quote: so he formed it into another vessel, as it seemed best for him to do.

q: After Jeremiah saw the potter, who did God say is like clay in His hand?
quote: Just like clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in My hand, O house of Israel.

q: After the potter's house, what did God ask Israel through Jeremiah?
a: Can I not treat you as clay?
why: God has the right to reshape us.
quote: can I not treat you as this potter treats his clay?

q: Later, what did the LORD tell Jeremiah to buy from a potter?
why: It became another lesson for the elders.
quote: Go and buy a clay jar from a potter.

q: God told Jeremiah He knew him before when?
why: God set him apart as a prophet.
quote: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you

q: When God called Jeremiah, what excuse did he give?
why: God told him not to say that.
quote: I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!

q: When God touched Jeremiah's mouth, what did He say He had put there?
quote: Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.

q: In Jeremiah, God says His plans for His people give them a future and what?
quote: plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.

q: Why did God tell young Jeremiah not to be afraid?
quote: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you

q: When God asked Jeremiah what he saw, what did he answer?
quote: I see a branch of an almond tree

q: In Jeremiah, God says you will find Him when you search with all your what?
quote: You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.

q: In Jeremiah, what does God promise to make with Israel and Judah?
why: His law will be on their hearts.
quote: when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

q: In Jeremiah's new covenant, where will God write His law?
quote: I will put My law in their minds and inscribe it on their hearts.

q: In Jeremiah, what does God promise if you call to Him?
quote: Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.

q: In Jeremiah, the one who trusts the LORD is like what planted by the waters?
why: It does not fear heat or drought.
quote: He is like a tree planted by the waters

q: In Jeremiah's prayer, what is too difficult for God?
quote: Nothing is too difficult for You!

q: Who wrote down Jeremiah's words on a scroll?
quote: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah

q: As Jeremiah's scroll was read to him, what did King Jehoiakim do with it?
why: He cut it piece by piece.
quote: Jehoiakim would cut them off with a scribe’s knife and throw them into the firepot

q: What was at the bottom of the cistern Jeremiah was dropped into?
quote: which had no water but only mud, and Jeremiah sank down into the mud.

q: Which court official rescued Jeremiah from the cistern?
quote: Now Ebed-melech the Cushite, a court official in the royal palace, heard that Jeremiah had been put into the cistern.

q: To pull Jeremiah from the cistern, what did Ebed-melech tell him to put under his arms?
quote: Put these worn-out rags and clothes under your arms to pad the ropes.

q: In Jeremiah, how long would the nations serve the king of Babylon?
quote: and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.

q: Jeremiah came from a family of priests in which town?
quote: one of the priests in Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.

q: Who was Jeremiah's father?
why: He was one of the priests.
quote: These are the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah

q: Who read Jeremiah's scroll aloud to King Jehoiakim?
quote: And as soon as Jehudi had read three or four columns

q: How many men did the king send with Ebed-melech to rescue Jeremiah?
why: They pulled him out with ropes.
quote: Take thirty men from here with you and pull Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies.

q: In Jeremiah, which animal cannot change its spots?
why: Habitual evil is hard to change.
quote: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots?

q: When Jeremiah tried not to speak God's message, what was it like in his heart?
why: He could not hold it in.
quote: His message becomes a fire burning in my heart, shut up in my bones

q: In Jeremiah, which family refused to drink wine because of their forefather's command?
why: Jonadab son of Rechab commanded it.
quote: for our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab commanded us

q: In Jeremiah, what should a person boast about?
quote: But let him who boasts boast in this, that he understands and knows Me
